lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters distributed across the mid-lateral surface. Pattern exhibits higher spatial density in the anterior region near the gill slits, transitioning to increased inter-centroid distances posteriorly along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, creating a coordinate-like grid of nodal points across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible, defined by sharp vertical pixel intensity gradients with high-luminance upper margins and low-luminance shadowed inferior margins, running parallel to the flank's longitudinal midline.
